scope: User-guided review of 16 remaining Dhaga questions

decisions.confirmed_interpretation: ତାଳ refers to ତାଳଫଳ, the palmyra fruit, compared with a tiny sesame seed.
decisions.user_statement: It refers to ତାଳଫଳ here—a tiny sesame seed compared with a large palmyra fruit. Let's keep that interpretation and move to the next Dhaga.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded; existing fruit interpretation retained. Qualification cleanup pending incorporation.

decisions.confirmed_interpretation: ଷାଠିଆ means a sixty-year-old person. The saying mocks someone who lacks possessions or capability but boasts: an empty betel pouch represents outward show without substance.
decisions.proposed_literal_meaning: A shameless sixty-year-old: no betel leaf, no areca nut, only an empty pouch!
decisions.proposed_meaning_odia: ପାଖରେ କିଛି ନଥାଇ କିମ୍ବା କୌଣସି କ୍ଷମତା ନଥାଇ ବଡ଼ବଡ଼ କଥା କହି ଫୁଟାଣି ମାରୁଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିକୁ ପରିହାସ କରି ଏହି ଢଗ କୁହାଯାଏ। ବଟୁଆ ଅଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଭିତରେ ପାନଗୁଆ ନାହିଁ—ବାହାରକୁ ଦେଖାଣି ଅଛି, ପ୍ରକୃତ ସମ୍ବଳ ନାହିଁ। ଏଠାରେ ଷାଠିଆ ଅର୍ଥ ଷାଠିଏ ବର୍ଷ ବୟସର ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି।
decisions.evidence_basis: Explicit user lexical clarification and supplied Odia explanation; not independently dictionary-verified.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.scope: Uploaded four-line variant; do not automatically restrict the independently attested short saying to this relationship.
decisions.user_interpretation: The four-line variant is a riddle whose answer is ଜ୍ୱାଇଁ (alternatively guest/friend). The seated figure stretches his legs comfortably while receiving hospitality. The in-laws miss him when absent, but speak little in his presence through customary reserve or shyness.
decisions.evidence_basis: User-supplied interpretation; not independently established as an exclusive traditional answer or universal family custom.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.
decisions.opening_line: ନଡିଆ–ଧଡିଆ is a rhyming opening, not a literal clue requiring a coconut-tree interpretation.
decisions.accepted_interpretation: Retain ଜ୍ୱାଇଁ as the user-confirmed interpretation of the uploaded four-line riddle. Preserve the broader meaning of the independently attested short saying.

decisions.confirmed_interpretation: ବାରବାଟି means ବାର ବାଟି ଜମି (twelve bati of land). The saying mocks boasting about cultivating a large area without the knowledge or ability to do so.
decisions.user_statement: Yes, ବାରବାଟି here means ବାର ବାଟି ଜମି—boasting about farming a large area without the knowledge or ability to do it. Let's keep that interpretation and move to the next Dhaga.
decisions.evidence_basis: Explicit user interpretation; no precise conversion of the historical land unit asserted.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.confirmed_interpretation: User reads ମାଳି as tulsi prayer beads, ଠକ ଠକ as their sound, and ଭଜନ ଟାଣ as singing bhajans loudly. The saying contrasts outward devotional display with the practical need for rice when hungry.
decisions.editorial_direction: Explain that display cannot satisfy basic needs. Do not infer that hunger or devotion itself proves hypocrisy. User also describes dependence on others and lack of work as applications; these are not literal clauses of the saying.
decisions.evidence_basis: User-supplied lexical and contextual interpretation; not independently dictionary-verified.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.confirmed_interpretation: User confirms ମୂଳପୋଛ କରିବା means to eradicate, uproot, or destroy completely, including eliminating a problem at its root.
decisions.editorial_direction: Retain the supported complete-destruction meaning for the paired variant. Omit an uncertain literal explanation; no claim that its literal image has been established.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.confirmed_interpretation: The ending means only then does that Brahmin get up: a description of exaggerated overeating, not a command.
decisions.editorial_direction: Update interpretation and translation to descriptive syntax. Preserve attested final ଉଠ; user confirmed meaning, not an orthographic change to ଉଠେ. Do not generalize the saying into a factual claim about a community.
decisions.evidence_basis: Explicit user interpretation; printed source retains ଉଠ.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.approved_display_wording: ସେ ହଗୁ ନାହିଁ କି ବାଟ ଛାଡୁ ନାହିଁ
decisions.confirmed_interpretation: Someone neither acts nor lets others act.
decisions.editorial_direction: Apply the user-authorized display correction ହଗ to ହଗୁ. Preserve original witness wording internally; do not present the correction as the printed source reading.
decisions.evidence_basis: Explicit user spelling correction and interpretation.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.editorial_direction: Keep the broad contextual rendering of ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ମୋହିଁଲେ without asserting cooking, coating, soaking or another precise physical process. The lexical process remains unestablished; the user accepts this wording as sufficient.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.confirmed_interpretation: The thief commits one sin; the person robbed suspects many innocent people and thus incurs many sins. The numerical contrast warns against groundless suspicion after a theft.
decisions.editorial_direction: Present suspicion of innocent people as the user-confirmed explanation. Distinguish this from treating the experience of being robbed itself as a fault.
decisions.evidence_basis: Explicit user confirmation of the interpretation.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.approved_display_wording:
ତିନି ଥେଣ୍ଟିଆ କାକୁଡ଼ି ବାଡ଼ି
ଶିଆଳ ଖାଏ ମୋଡି ମାଡି।
decisions.confirmed_interpretation: Three people share responsibility but each leaves the work to the others, so the cucumber crop goes unprotected.
decisions.editorial_direction: Replace displayed କାକୁଡି ଭାଡି with user-approved କାକୁଡ଼ି ବାଡ଼ି; preserve the original uploaded wording internally. Use cucumber garden/patch rather than trellis in explanation.
decisions.evidence_basis: Explicit user wording correction and interpretation.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.confirmed_interpretation: When money or resources are available, the hand is restless to spend and the person readily spends unnecessarily; without resources, one suffers distress and hardship. The saying warns against wasteful spending without saving.

lexical_clarification.ଖଲ ଖଲ: ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ଚଞ୍ଚଳ ବା ଅସ୍ଥିର ହେବା

decisions.editorial_direction: Replace the broad lively/freedom-to-act interpretation with the user-confirmed spending impulse and contrast with distress in shortage.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.user_interpretation: Visible or present frog is food for tiger/large predator; hidden frog is food for snake; danger in either situation.
decisions.editorial_direction: Retain plenty-versus-scarcity interpretation. Preserve ସାପର ଆହାର without supplying an uncertain figurative rationale. Set aside the proposed frog/riddle reading; do not incorporate it into the collection.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.
decisions.accepted_interpretation: Contrast between plentiful eating when food is available and scarcity when it is not.
decisions.proposed_answer_status: Set aside by explicit user direction; retained here only as discussion history.

decisions.confirmed_interpretation: The saying criticizes a person who avoids directly refusing, repeatedly promises to give or help, but keeps delaying and gives nothing, leaving the requester waiting in hope.
decisions.editorial_direction: Use the user-confirmed evasive/unfulfilled-promise interpretation instead of leaving sincerity and fulfilment undecided. Preserve source wording and distinguish idiomatic meaning from added literal words.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.

decisions.user_interpretation: Son’s son grows up nearby and preserves lineage; daughter’s son lives far away and grandparents pray for his welfare. User associates first image with hunting porcupines or small activities and second with distant prayers.
decisions.editorial_direction: Retain original କାତି spelling; use quill in the explanation and translation. Set aside the proposed nearby-versus-distant family narrative. Do not present the contextual reading as independently established dictionary equivalence.
decisions.publication_status: Decision recorded for incorporation; website/book not yet changed.
decisions.accepted_interpretation: Retain କାତି and interpret it contextually as a porcupine’s quill. Keep the contrast between hurt and heavenly light.
decisions.earlier_interpretation_status: Nearby-versus-distant family account explicitly set aside by user; retained only as discussion history.

decisions.user_proposed_context: An abused daughter-in-law privately voices suffering; claimed linked book as evidence.

verified_source.title: ହାଣ୍ଡିଶାଳରୁ ରାଜଦରବାର
verified_source.author: ମନୋରମା ମହାପାତ୍ର
verified_source.access: Full ebook HTML retrieved and relevant passage plus surrounding paragraphs read.
verified_source.wording:
କହିବି ନାହିଁ, କହିଲେ ଏ ଘରେ ରହିବି ନାହିଁ,
ଖଣ୍ଡିଆ ପଥୁରି ଧୋଇବି ନାହିଁ,
ତାଟି କିଳା ଭାତ ଖାଇବି ନାହିଁ ।
verified_source.context: Political deception, dependence on leaders, flattery and staying silent because speaking openly threatens one’s place. This occurrence does not establish the claimed daughter-in-law narrative or earliest origin.

decisions.editorial_direction: Use the verified book text as the proposed main version; preserve upload separately. Do not assert that the saying originated in abuse of daughters-in-law, that domestic washing is inherently degrading, or that the source proves a particular family narrative. Keep literal details distinct from interpretive implications.
remaining_questions: Historical origin remains unverified and should be omitted; exact figurative implications of the final line are not independently established.
decisions.publication_status: Discussion synthesis recorded; website/book not yet changed.
decisions.preferred_version: Verified OVA book wording explicitly selected by user.
decisions.proposed_interpretation: The speaker is unwilling to speak openly because doing so could cost their place in the household, and voices refusal of the circumstances evoked by washing a chipped stone bowl and eating behind a fastened door. Self-respect is a user-supplied interpretive emphasis, not a demonstrated historical origin.

additional_source_check.access: Metadata, OCR and 14-page PDF retrieved. OCR unusable; scan pages4–9 inspected, including printed କ section on pages6–7. No exact target verse found in that inspected section. This is not an exhaustive exclusion of the saying elsewhere.
additional_source_check.conclusion: No verified supporting passage for the claimed daughter-in-law origin.
